name: dmitriy-claude-plugins
description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins for development workflows and productivity

plugins.name: unity-dev
plugins.description: Unity C# development workflow with architecture design, coding guidelines, testing patterns, and specialized review agents

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Python development workflow with architecture design, coding guidelines, testing patterns, and specialized review agents

plugins.name: typescript-dev
plugins.description: TypeScript development workflow with architecture design, coding guidelines, testing patterns, and specialized review agents

plugins.name: agent-teams
plugins.description: Set up and orchestrate Claude Code agent teams - multiple instances working together with shared tasks, messaging, and coordination

plugins.name: codex-collaboration
plugins.description: Cross-model collaboration between Claude and Codex — sequential drive/validate/act loops and parallel dual review with triage

plugins.name: implementation-prd
plugins.description: Implementation-ready spec bundle authoring for apps, services, platforms, and complex features

plugins.name: learning-guide
plugins.description: Generate a single-file, interactive HTML learning guide for any artifact — codebase, planning session, refactor plan, or generic input — via an analyze → render flow with a JSON tour-spec contract

plugins.name: lsp-setup
plugins.description: Set up LSP (Language Server Protocol) for Claude Code projects with auto-detection, plugin installation, and validation

plugins.name: tg-essentials
plugins.description: Telegram toolkit: error and alert notifications for any project through a bot, plus reading and writing Telegram as yourself from the local Telegram Desktop session (chats, exports, groups, posts, checklists)

plugins.name: tg-voice
plugins.description: Transcribe Telegram voice messages using local Whisper (faster-whisper) — automatic PostToolUse hook with setup skill for installation and model download

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove AI-generation patterns from English or Russian text — auto-detects language and applies a matching MIT-licensed ruleset (33-pattern EN from blader/humanizer, 54-pattern RU from ilyautov/humanizer-ru) with explicit override and mixed-text handling

plugins.name: agent-dispatch
plugins.description: Start issue-to-pr runs from GitHub labels on your own machine: a scheduled tick picks the issue you labelled agent, or the one you replied on, and runs it headless under your own Claude Code or Codex login, on Windows, macOS or Linux.

plugins.name: issue-to-pr
plugins.description: Take a GitHub issue (bare, or tracked on a Project board) from triage to a merge-ready PR through a gated, worktree-isolated pipeline that scales its depth to the task and asks at most one batched question. The gates hold every run: design hardening, tests green, code review clean. Once you approve the PR in-session it squash-merges, reporting GitHub's own message if the merge is refused, then tears down the branch and worktree; a merge into anything but the default branch is reported as one, since that is where the issue's auto-close depends. The board card advances as work moves.

plugins.name: claude-md-slim
plugins.description: Shrink an oversized or stale CLAUDE.md by moving subsystem detail into path-scoped .claude/rules/ files, with scripts that measure the loaded size against the documented 200-line budget and prove the extraction lost nothing
